root: ^WASD - Choose the dialogue choice you prefer. Enter - Select the choice. Space - Progress and close out of dialogue.
^Sam: Good evening, Mrs. Maloney. How can I be of help today?

s: ^"'I want some potatoes please, Sam. Yes, and I think a can of peas."'(Dahl 4)
^Patrick won't eat out tonight. He said he's got something to do.
^Patrick's leaving me, Sam, and he's saying "Don't make a fuss, it's bad for my job"!

c-0: ^"'Patrick's decided he's tired and doesn't want to eat out tonight. We usually go out Thursdays, you know, and now he's caught me without any vegetables in the house."'(Dahl 4)
^"'No, I've got meat, thanks. I got a nice leg of lamb from the freezer"'(Dahl 4).
^"'I don’t much like cooking it frozen, Sam, but I’m taking a chance on it this time. You think it’ll be all right?"'(Dahl 4).
^Sam: "'Personally, I don’t believe it makes any difference. You want these Idaho potatoes?"'(Dahl 4).

s: ^"'Oh yes, that’ll be fine. Two of those"'(Dahl 4).
^Do you have any others? The Idaho ones gave Patrick food poisoning last week; I'd rather stay away from them for now.

c-0: ^Sam: "'Anything else? How about afterwards? What you going to give him for afterwards?"'(Dahl 4).
^Sam: "'How about a nice big slice of cheesecake? I know he likes that"'(Dahl 4).
^"'Perfect, He loves it. Thank you, Sam. Goodnight"'(Dahl 4).
c-1: ^Sam: I understand. Anything else? How about afterwards? What you going to give him for afterwards?.
^Sam: "'How about a nice big slice of cheesecake? I know he likes that"'(Dahl 4).

s: ^"'Perfect, He loves it. Thank you, Sam. Goodnight"'(Dahl 4).
^I'm afraid he won't be needing them tonight, Sam.

c-1: ^Oh, I must be getting delirious. I should head home now. Thank you, Sam. Goodnight.
^Sam: Very well then. Will it be the usual, peas?
^Sure. Add some potatoes to that as well will you?
^Sam: My pleasure. What is Patrick up to tonight anyway?
^I'm uh.. not totally sure Sam. You know he doesn't tell me all that much. Anyways, have a nice evening.
^Sam: Oh yes, you as well madam.
c-2: ^Sam: Oh my, Mrs. Maloney. What a scoundrel he is! In any case, I'm a grocer, and it's not my place to intervene.
^I'm aware Sam. Thank you, though. May I please have some peas and potatoes for dinner tonight?
^Sam: Certainly, madam! Everything alright Mrs. Maloney? You seem a bit flushed.

s: ^I'm rather tired, Sam. Must be the baby.
^Oh yes! I..I.. I'm fine really. Just a bit flustered from the unfortunate news. Surely you must understand?

c-0: ^Sam: Of course Mrs. Maloney. Sorry for the intrusion.
^No worries, Sam. I think I should be going now, though. Have a nice evening.
^Sam: Oh yes, you as well madam.
c-1: ^Sam: Of course Mrs. Maloney. Sorry for the intrusion.
^Anyways, I must hurry home now. Bye, Sam.
